title: On plane Cremona maps of degree 4 and length 2
summary: Plane Cremona maps of degree four are divided into two different classes according to their homaloidal type: either they are de Jonquières, that is, they have a base point of multiplicity 3, or they are not de Jonquières. The maps of the former class have length one, while the maps of the latter class have length two, according to the definition of length of a plane Cremona map given by Blanc and Furter.
